title: Hunyuan3D-Part: an open-source part-level 3D shape generation model that outperforms all existing open and close-source models.
author: Unreal_777

comments.author: 3dutchie3dprinting
comments.body:
This is part of their 3d studio right? I’ve managed to get access to it’s beta and it indeed is amazing, currently you can only upload FBX files (which hunyuan-3d can also output through their site) and it does split files properly.

It’s also very easy to merge parts but also split parts even further.

My biggest problem in my tests is that sometimes parts would be hollow instead of solid which would be an issue during printing (what I use hunyuan for)

Yo, this is really cool!

I am not really knowledgeable about this, but do I understand it right, that:

1. Basically, you can generate an image with a prompt and/or your own photo/picture.
2. Put it in Hunyuan, so it will make a 3D model of the generated image.
3. Use that 3D model to print a real life object via a 3D printer?
